component.name: Tablet Center
component.summary: Settings app and daemon for Wacom pen tablets on GNOME (Wayland)

description.p: Tablet Center is a settings app and a small daemon for Wacom pen tablets on GNOME (Wayland). It adds features the Linux driver lacks, starting with pan scroll as it works on macOS.

Features include pan scroll, pen gestures, on-screen shortcuts (Express menu, Radial menu, App shortcuts, Keypad), pen button configuration, tip feel pressure curves, display mapping, ExpressKeys, and more.
Beta: the Flatpak install now runs a working daemon and detects the tablet reliably.

ul.li: Flatpak setup stages the tabletd daemon on the host and points the systemd unit at it, so the driver actually starts.
The udev rule grants uaccess ACLs for tablets, mice and touchpads; the daemon no longer depends on a freshly re-login group membership.
Host setup re-runs when the installed rule is outdated, restarts the daemon after privileged steps, and shows a live step-by-step progress log.
Persistent setup notices on home and settings; the app prompts whenever host integration is incomplete.
Restart Driver works from the Flatpak (systemctl routed to the host).

description.p: Fixes the Flatpak host integration setup: the administrator prompt is now the standard desktop dialog (polkit) instead of sudo, and the setup dialog can no longer be skipped.
Pre-release with Flatpak bundle support, host integration, and Linux Wayland pen tablet enhancements.
